briefing: Teal never signed your checkout. Fly the training pattern, practice the controls, then select and hit the training radar. No enemies.
debrief: Checkout interrupted: six bombers are crossing the islands. Mission 1 is ready when you are.
failure: The checkout can be flown again.

phases.beat: Tap turn and pitch briefly. Three seconds TOTAL each; impacts reset you.
phases.label: Practice short turn and pitch taps

phases.beat: Select radar: tap box / TGT / Tab / Y. Turn back if you pass it.
phases.label: Cycle to the training target

phases.beat: Aim for LOCK, then FIRE / Space / RT. Pull up after firing.
phases.label: Lock and hit the training radar

title: Practice

briefing: Teal's unsigned checkout is cut short. Six bombers in Varda's own paint are crossing the islands toward Varda Rim's runway on the headland. They squawk our codes; the warning came late. You are the nearest jet. Fly off the training carrier and stop them. Escorts are optional targets.
debrief: The six bombers are down and Varda Rim's runway is clear. The quartermaster hands you a sealed case from Teal's bunk, addressed to Sera.
failure: The raid was not stopped. Varda Rim's runway remains under threat.

phases.beat: Six bombers, our paint and codes. Stop them before the north coast.

bombers.escapeCall: The bombers crossed the north coast. Varda Rim, clear the runway.

phases.label: Intercept six bombers

primary: Destroy all six bombers before they leave the island
title: OUR OWN PAINT

briefing: The grain drums in Teal's manifest lead north to a 'farm' with a runway and no animals. Yesterday's bombers flew from it; eleven more are parked on its pads. Follow the power line and destroy them before they raid. Hangars, AA guns, the tower and the substation are optional. Hit aircraft, not the farmhouses.
debrief: All eleven bombers are burning on their pads. The farm will not launch another raid. The manifest points recovery toward Teal's beacons in the pass.
failure: The bombers survived. The farm can launch its next raid.

phases.beat: SERA: Follow the power line north. Their bombers are parked on the farm.

chatter.text: FARM CONTROL: Bombers, start engines! Get them off the ground!
SERA: Four down. Their guns are still up, watch the base edges.
FARM CONTROL: The pads are burning. Nobody takes off from here.
LANTERN 2: One bomber left. Finish it, trainee.

fighterWaves.call: LANTERN 2: Two bandits off the nose, low over the fields.
FARM CONTROL: Raid from the south. This is not a drill!
FARM CONTROL: Runway is yours. Get up, get up!
SERA: Two more from the west valley. They waited for you.

phases.label: Destroy eleven parked bombers

standaloneAce.call: HARROW SIX: Harrow Six, rolling in. Get off my pads, trainee.
standaloneAce.name: HARROW SIX
stageLines: HARROW SIX: Varda paint on a Varda kid. Shame to waste it.
HARROW SIX: Harrow, breaking low. Somebody cover the bombers!

primary: Destroy all eleven parked bombers on the farm airfield
title: NO ANIMALS

briefing: Teal's receiver names a radar inside our own training box that nobody signed for: nine domes on two snowy mountain sites north-west of the pass. Destroy all nine with the gun camera running, then turn south across the return line and land with the film. AA guns and a parked helicopter are optional.
debrief: Nine domes are down and the film is home. Sera locks the gun-camera tape in her desk: the station watched trainees, and its memory names the Teklan orchard.
failure: The station is still watching, and the film never reached Varda Rim.

phases.beat: SERA: Enemy airspace. Site one is on the ridge north-west of you.

chatter.text: LANTERN 2: Dome down. Good hit, trainee.
SERA: Five domes down. Site two is on the saddle west-north-west.
LANTERN 2: One dome left. Finish it and we go home.

fighterWaves.call: RIDGE STATION: Intruders from the south-east. Fighters, intercept.
RIDGE STATION: Escorts, keep them away from the domes!
SERA: Site one is silent. Three fighters inbound from the west.

phases.label: Destroy nine radar domes

standaloneAce.call: CAIRN LEAD: You found our little station. Now you stay up here.
standaloneAce.name: CAIRN LEAD
stageLines: CAIRN LEAD: A training jet. They sent a training jet.
CAIRN LEAD: Missile! Breaking hard. Cairn is hit!

update.objective: Return to base: fly south across the return line
radio: SERA: All nine domes confirmed destroyed. Good work.
SERA: All aircraft, turn south. Cross the return line to leave the area.
SERA: Follow the green cue to the white dashes on the ground below.

radio.text: RIM TOWER: Trainee, gear check. Cleared to land, runway three-six.
RIM TOWER: Runway in sight. You're on the centreline.
RIM TOWER: Short final. Glide path is good, hold it there.
RIM TOWER: Touchdown. Nice and gentle.
RIM TOWER: Welcome home. Sera wants that film before you unstrap.

primary: Destroy all nine radar domes, then return to base
title: NOBODY SIGNED

briefing: The radar memory names the Teklan orchard. Three high couriers are the patrols' eyes over the evacuation road. Destroy all three before they escape along the harbour route. Two airborne jammers hide their escorts; find them by eye or destroy the optional jammers to restore radar.
debrief: The high flyers are gone. The trucks reach Varda; the lead driver's granddaughter marks the fuel works on Sera's map.
failure: The patrols still have their eyes above the orchard. The evacuation road is unsafe.

phases.beat: SERA: High flyers ahead. Break their jammers to get radar back.

bombers.escapeCall: SERA: A courier reached the harbour route. Pull back.

chatter.text: SERA: One courier down. Two still watching the road.
LANTERN 2: One transport left. The trucks are counting on us.

fighterWaves.call: COURIER GUARD: They found us. Send the reserve flight!

jamming.clearCall: SERA: Both jammers down. Radar is clear. Find those transports.
jamming.remainingCall: SERA: Still jammed. A second aircraft is masking the couriers.

phases.label: Intercept three transports

standaloneAce.call: ORCHARD WARRANT: Keep the couriers flying. I will take the trainee.
standaloneAce.name: ORCHARD WARRANT
stageLines: ORCHARD WARRANT: Guard flight, keep them off my tail!
ORCHARD WARRANT: The road is ours as long as one courier flies.

primary: Destroy all three transports before they escape
title: BLIND COURIERS

briefing: The granddaughter marked the tanks hidden under grain permits. Strike the refinery and offshore rig under the searchlights. Reach 2,000 points in ten minutes and keep burning until the clock expires. Rearm at the southern base if needed. When Vulture Lead arrives, escape his squadron across the return line.
debrief: The fuel works are burning. You escaped Vulture Lead; Sera recorded his relayed orders while he hunted you. Their signatures lead to Iron Coast.
failure: The fuel trail and the pilot carrying it have not reached safety.

phases.beat: SERA: Rig to the east, refinery to the west. Burn them before dawn.

chatter.text: LANTERN 2: Tanks are going up like flares. Keep it coming.
SERA: Halfway there. The platform's guns are still awake.
LANTERN 3: Nearly there. Don't stop at the number, trainee.
SERA: That's two thousand. Keep burning it until the clock runs out.

fighterWaves.call: SERA: Two interceptors off the platform, low over the water.
LANTERN 2: Helicopters lifting off the platform. Three of them.
WORKS CONTROL: All reserves, get up! Protect the platform!
SERA: Two more bandits, bearing three-three-zero. Fast movers.

phases.label: Score 2,000 points before 10:00

radio.text: SHORE TOWER: Trainee, you're cleared to land, runway one-eight.
SHORE TOWER: One mile. On the glide path, hold it there.
SHORE TOWER: Touchdown. Ground crew's loading you now.
SHORE TOWER: Cleared for takeoff. Height limit lifted. Go back.

standaloneAce.call: CINDER LEAD: Cinder Lead on station. Nobody burns my works and leaves.
standaloneAce.name: CINDER LEAD
stageLines: CINDER LEAD: That's a trainee? Somebody lied to me.
CINDER LEAD: Cinder is hit! Breaking off over the tanks!

after: VULTURE LEAD: Vulture flight, you're cleared. Anything that isn't ours.
LANTERN 3: Don't engage them! Jettison and run for the line!

captions.text: LANTERN 2: Five of them. No lights. That's the Vulture flight.
SERA: All aircraft, disengage. Head south across the line, now.

standaloneAce.name: VULTURE LEAD
stageLines: VULTURE LEAD: Teal flew like that. Right up until the pass.
VULTURE LEAD: Vulture Lead is hit. Somebody get this kid off me!

update.objective: Withdraw south across the line before the clock runs out
radio: SERA: Clock's out and the works is burning. Good. Now go south.
SERA: Vulture flight inbound. Leave the works. Survive; this is no duel.

primary: Score 2,000 points at the fuel works within 10:00, then withdraw south
title: LIGHTS OFF

briefing: Vulture Lead's guard-channel orders are signed by a man who died in spring. The chain ends at Iron Coast. Strike the docked warships and fuel barges; AA guards the docks. Workers and the fish market are nearby. Use the service stop if needed.
debrief: The warships and fuel barges are gone. Harbour traffic gives Sera Kiro's signing key. Two more station logs will prove whose hand used it.
failure: The harbour supply line holds. Sera still has only one link in the order chain.

phases.beat: SERA: Iron Coast. Warships and fuel barges only; leave the market clear.

chatter.text: LANTERN 2: Ships are slipping their moorings. Catch them in the basin.
SERA: Halfway. The pontoon SAMs are still awake. Mind the warnings.
LANTERN 3: Nearly there. Don't stop at the number, trainee.
SERA: Harbour traffic copied. We can follow the orders inland.

fighterWaves.call: SERA: Four fighters up from the harbour field. They saw you coming.
LANTERN 2: Helicopters lifting off the central quay.
LANTERN 3: Two strike jets low over the east basin. Coming for us.
HARBOUR CONTROL: All flights, launch! Defend the fleet!
SERA: Two more from the south, off the outer channel.
LANTERN 2: Another pair inbound. They're throwing everything up.

phases.label: Score 3,000 points before 15:00

radio.text: COAST TOWER: Trainee, cleared to land, runway one-eight. Wind calm.
COAST TOWER: One mile. Slightly high. Ease it down.
COAST TOWER: Down and rolling. Crews are bringing the racks out.
COAST TOWER: Racks full, magazine full. Cleared for takeoff.

standaloneAce.call: WARDEN LEAD: Warden Lead. Those ships are my charge, trainee.
standaloneAce.name: WARDEN LEAD
stageLines: WARDEN LEAD: You fly like Teal. He didn't listen either.
WARDEN LEAD: Warden is hit! Breaking off over the quays!

primary: Score 3,000 points at the Iron Coast quays within 15:00
title: IRON COAST

briefing: Kiro's key needs matching logs from Lira and Merel. Cross the hills low at sunset, copy the array traffic and cut the transmitters. Long-range guns watch the ridges; drop into the canyon when they find you.
debrief: Three stations carry one signature. Varda's island transmitter can send the proof in thirty-five seconds.
failure: The array logs are incomplete. The forgery still has room to hide.

phases.beat: SERA: Copy before you cut. We need the signature, not just wreckage.

chatter.text: SERA: Lira log copied. Keep moving to the next installation.
SERA: Merel log copied. One transmitter remains.

phases.label: Copy logs; cut three transmitters

update.objective: Descend below 2,000 ft; use canyon cover and exit south
radio: SERA: Guns have the ridge. Take the canyon.

primary: Destroy three marked installations in 15:00, then escape south in 5:00
title: ARRAY BREAK

briefing: Varda's island transmitter will broadcast Teal's thirty-five seconds. Sera stays in the tower. Hold the tropical island's sky against the fighters and bomber wave until the signal is out, then clear the remaining attackers.
debrief: The broadcast is out. Three garrisons heard it. Two stood down and are coming ashore to join us.
failure: The transmitter could not hold the window. The garrisons have not heard the proof.

phases.beat: SERA: I stay in the tower. Keep bombers off the transmitter.
phases.label: Score 800 points before 7:00

bombers.escapeCall: SERA: A bomber reached the tower. We have lost the transmitter.

interceptHold.ignitionCall: SERA: Transmitter is live. Hold this sky for thirty-five seconds.

update.objective: Destroy six western bombers; protect the transmitter until 0:00
radio: SERA: Six bombers west. Keep them off the tower until the window closes.

primary: Score 800 in 7:00, then intercept six western bombers and hold the transmitter for 6:00
title: OPEN FREQUENCY

briefing: The garrisons that stood down are landing under the weather. Loyalist frigates cover them. Score 2,200 in ten minutes against the coastal guns, then stop nine attack jets in seven minutes. Clear each beach's two batteries to release its landing craft. Keep all three landing forces alive. Weapons are finite; the offshore carrier can rearm you during the beach strike.
debrief: The landing holds. Then the Marshal answers Varda's broadcast: the Teklan orchard burns, and his guns close the river valleys.
failure: The beach guns still hold the landing offshore.

phases.beat: SERA: Green beacon is ours. Clear the guns above the beach.

chatter.text: SERA: Teal taught us: weather hides a turn. Keep moving.

phases.label: Suppress the three beach sectors

radio.text: DECK: Green deck. Bring her down on the angled stripe.
DECK: Weapons aboard. Taxi to the bow for launch.

chatter.text: SERA: The landing is through. There is smoke over Teklan.

fighterWaves.call: SERA: Three attack jets closing on the west landing.
SERA: Three attack jets closing on the central landing.
SERA: Three attack jets closing on the east landing.

sectors.advanceCall: SHORE: west guns clear. Landing craft advancing.
sectors.hitCall: SHORE: west landing force under air attack!

sectors.advanceCall: SHORE: central guns clear. Landing craft advancing.
sectors.hitCall: SHORE: central landing force under air attack!

sectors.advanceCall: SHORE: east guns clear. Landing craft advancing.
sectors.hitCall: SHORE: east landing force under air attack!

update.objective: Stop all nine attack jets; protect the landing forces
radio: SERA: Attack jets inbound. Keep them off the green beacons.

primary: Score 2,200 in 10:00; stop nine attack jets in 7:00
title: GREEN BEACON

briefing: The orchard burned in reprisal. Its survivors are alive, but the Marshal's defensive line closes the rivers. Break the positions along the forested valleys. Stay below the long-range guns and use the service stop if needed.
debrief: The river line is broken. The orchard survivors can fly out over the snowy saddle on two civilian airliners.
failure: The river line holds. The survivors still have no safe crossing.
title: Mission 10

briefing: Two civilian airliners carry the orchard survivors over the snowy saddle. One cannot climb. Move between their altitude bands and keep hostile fighters off both aircraft. These families trusted Teal; now they are trusting you.
debrief: Both airliners are clear. Sera matches Vulture Two's checkride signature to the forged orders. He is waiting over the command array.
failure: The families did not make the crossing safely.
title: Mission 11

briefing: The eight towers in the crater are the Marshal's command array. Destroy them; use the service landing if needed. Vulture Two is waiting after the last tower. Defeat him and mark his ejection so the marines can recover a living witness.
debrief: Vulture Two ejected and was recovered. He admits the handwriting is his. His statement and the harbour master's paper copy leave on an evidence plane.
failure: The array or its guardian still controls the crater. No witness has been recovered.
title: Mission 12

briefing: A slow reconnaissance plane carries the paper copy and Vulture Two's statement through a fog-filled ravine. Silence the airship jammers, then intercept the fighters before they reach it. The archive he points to is still on the ice coast.
debrief: The evidence plane is clear. The crown station holds the first order; missiles are already on their way to silence it.
failure: The evidence plane did not get through. The paper trail is still trapped.
title: Mission 13

briefing: The crown station stands on the ice coast under the aurora. Its archive holds the first signed order. Stop every low-flying cruise missile before it reaches the dish; keep it transmitting until the record is received.
debrief: Archive received. ORDER 0001: RUSK, AIR MARSHAL. Sera finally has a name for the voice holding the city.
failure: The dish fell before the whole archive arrived. The first signature is lost.
title: Mission 14

briefing: ORDER 0001 names Rusk. His relay holds the lit city on one repeated emergency. Silence it, cover the loyalist ground forces against armour and helicopters, then stop the bomber retaliation. Use the service stop if needed.
debrief: The city hears silence for the first time since spring. Rusk addresses the trainee by his own name while parliament's column approaches the dry coast.
failure: The city remains under Rusk's voice and guns.
title: Mission 15

briefing: Parliament follows a loyalist column across the dry coast. Clear the crater, bunkers and ruined town ahead of its armour. The airbase can service you. Stay until both squads answer from the streets.
debrief: The column is through. Recovery reaches the upper pass and finds Teal in his aircraft, his recorder still running. The witnesses head for parliament.
failure: The column cannot reach the town. Parliament is still outside its own city.
title: Mission 16

briefing: Teal's last tape buys the witnesses their voice tonight. Keep the flooded capital's bridges and docks open. Break the defences, then defeat Rusk's four wingmen, including Vulture Lead. Rusk withdraws to sea; he must survive for the final confrontation.
debrief: Vulture Lead and the other three wingmen are down. Rusk abandoned them and ran to the coastal relay works. The witnesses reach parliament; his own voice is all he has left.
failure: The witnesses cannot reach parliament. The bridges and docks remain under fire.
title: Mission 17

briefing: Rusk's coastal relay works repeat his voice through the storm. Destroy three generators inside the grooves, run the central vent and escape. When the works fall silent, Rusk rises alone. Shoot him down in open air; then broadcast in your own voice.
debrief: Rusk is down. The relay is dark. Every harbour is listening for the trainee's voice.
failure: The relay has not been silenced. Rusk still owns the frequency.
title: Mission 18
